label: TP
reason: User input from getQueryString flows directly through URL decoding into a printf format string sink without proper HTML entity encoding or context-aware escaping. The replace operation attempts to inject 'Z' characters but does not sanitize malicious payloads like script tags or event handlers.

evidence.note: User-controlled param flows directly to printf sink without adequate XSS prevention
URL decoding preserves special characters including <script> tags
